actions.name: Data Inventory
actions.description: Data inventorying identifies and records the schemas, formats, volumes, and locations of data stored and used on the organization's architecture.
actions.reason: Data inventorying ensures data sources and locations are documented, which is foundational for acquiring data appropriately.

actions.name: Access Modeling
actions.description: Access modeling captures and records the access permissions granted to identities (e.g., administrators, users, groups, systems) and optionally includes details on how these identities are stored, managed, and shared across systems.
actions.reason: Access modeling establishes permissions for data usage, ensuring only authorized entities can acquire data.

actions.name: Control Access to ML Models and Data at Rest
actions.description: Establish access controls on internal model registries and limit internal access to production models. Limit access to training data only to approved users.
actions.reason: Controls access to training data, directly aligning with appropriate data acquisition by restricting unauthorized access.

actions.name: Encrypt Sensitive Information
actions.description: Encrypt sensitive data such as ML models to protect against adversaries attempting to access sensitive data.
actions.reason: Encrypts sensitive data during acquisition, ensuring confidentiality and integrity of data used for AI systems.

actions.name: Monitoring and auditing
actions.description: Regularly monitoring and auditing the model’s use can help detect and prevent theft by detecting when an attacker is attempting to access or steal the model.
actions.reason: Monitors data access patterns to detect and prevent unauthorized or inappropriate data acquisition activities.

subgoals.control_name: Data quality requirements shall be defined and checked.

actions.name: Data Inventory
actions.description: Data inventorying identifies and records the schemas, formats, volumes, and locations of data stored and used on the organization's architecture.
actions.reason: Data inventorying provides foundational information about data schemas, formats, and locations, which is essential for defining data quality requirements.

actions.name: File Metadata Consistency Validation
actions.description: The process of validating the consistency between a file's metadata and its actual content, ensuring that elements like declared lengths, pointers, and checksums accurately describe the file's content.
actions.reason: Validating metadata consistency ensures that data meets structural and format requirements, directly supporting data quality definitions.

actions.name: Content Validation
actions.description: Verify and validate contents complies with policy
actions.reason: Content validation confirms compliance with policy-based quality standards, aligning with the goal of defining data quality requirements.

actions.name: Input validation
actions.description: Implement input validation and content filtering
actions.reason: Input validation ensures data meets predefined criteria, directly contributing to establishing and enforcing data quality requirements.

actions.name: Sanitize Training Data
actions.description:
Detect and remove or remediate poisoned training data. Training data should be sanitized prior to model training and recurrently for an active learning model.
Implement a filter to limit ingested training data. Establish a content policy that would remove unwanted content such as certain explicit or offensive language from being used.
actions.reason: Sanitizing training data removes poisoned or low-quality data, ensuring the dataset meets quality standards required for defined requirements.

actions.name: Verify the authenticity of feedback data
actions.description: Use techniques such as digital signatures and checksums to verify that the feedback data received by the system is genuine, and reject any data that does not match the expected format.
actions.reason: Verifies authenticity of feedback data using checksums and digital signatures, ensuring data integrity and reliability.
